info.name: Inventory Import API
info.description: Upload a product file (.csv, .xls, .xlsx), poll the import until it finishes, and page through the imported rows. Dates are detected automatically, so there is no date format to choose.

request.description: Uploads a .csv, .xls or .xlsx file and queues it. Returns 202 with an importId; the rows are read on a worker thread, so poll 'Get import status' for progress. A file whose contents do not match its extension, or that has no recognisable header row, is refused here with 400.
Status is PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED or FAILED. The counters climb while it runs, because each chunk of rows is committed as it is read. On FAILED, summary.failureMessage says why.
Every source row number this import rejected, for an import that rejected more than the handful echoed in the status response.
Totals for the dashboard card, over the whole inventory rather than one import: totalProducts, totalInventoryValue and averageStockAgeDays.

query.description: One of: rowNumber, productSku, productName, category, purchaseDate, unitPrice, quantity, lineValue, stockAgeDays.

Cursor-paged, not offset-paged: pass the previous response's nextCursor here. Leave empty for the first page. Changing sortBy or direction invalidates a cursor, so start a fresh walk when the sort changes.

request.description: A page of imported rows for the dashboard table, including the derived lineValue and stockAgeDays columns. Follow nextCursor until hasMore is false.
